en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 143 - It is narrated from Muhammad bin Ali from Husain bin Muhammad Qati from Ali bin Hatim from Muhammad bin Marwan from Ubaid bin Yahya Thawri from Muhammad bin Husain from his father from his grandfather from Amirul Momineen (a.s)
that he said with regard to the following verse: “And We desired to bestow a favor upon those who were deemed weak in the land, and to make them the Imams, and to make them the heirs…” [28:5]
“They are Aale Muhammad (a.s). Allah will raise their Mahdi after their distress, so he will honor them and will disgrace their enemy.”
